//: Optional house rules (not B/X RAW), speced for later implementation.

rules.name: Sense Deceit
rules.description: Lets a PC attempt to tell whether an NPC is lying when they ask directly. The referee rolls this check in secret and narrates the result; the player never sees the die.

resolution.when: PC explicitly asks whether an NPC's current statement is a lie
procedure: A roll equal to or under the PC's chance detects the truth: the PC senses the NPC is lying (or is not, if they ask about a genuine statement).
Never reveal the roll or the chance to the player; narrate only the in-fiction tell.

modifiers.condition: NPC is a skilled liar (cultured/intelligent class, spy, courtier)
PC and NPC share a common language

notes: Only tests the statement the PC asks about, not general character knowledge.
If the check succeeds and the NPC is lying, the PC knows the statement is false, but not the truth behind it.
If the check succeeds and the NPC is truthful, the PC senses sincerity.
A failed check reveals nothing; the PC remains unsure. This is a house rule — B/X RAW has no perception/insight mechanic for social situations.
